description: This file defines a validator for Kubernetes string formats, including registration, validation logic, and documentation for format tags used in code generation.

classes.name: formatTagValidator
classes.description: Validator for Kubernetes string format tags, providing validation scope, tag name, and documentation.

methods.name: TagName
methods.description: Returns the name of the tag this validator handles.

methods.name: ValidScopes
methods.description: Returns the set of valid scopes for this tag.

methods.name: GetValidations
methods.description: Retrieves validation functions based on the tag value, applicable to string types.

methods.name: Docs
methods.description: Provides documentation details for the format tag, including description and payloads.
